_about: What score.py measures for mates_task_v2 (tools/bench/mates_task/measure_blend.py). The answers below follow from the brief: deck top z 6, pan servo case top 46, pan horn disc top 53.8, tilt axis 40 above it at z 93.8 crossing the pan axis along Y, tilt servo spline top at y 23.9 (case y -20..20), camera lens on the board back at (25, 0, 93.8). Tolerances 0.2 mm and 1 deg. senses: the world axis a positive brief value turns about at home (pan counter-clockwise from above, tilt + raises); a design whose PIV turns the other way is posed with negated values. Clearances are measured over the brief's pan x tilt grid.

BUY_servo_pan.why: upright on the deck top, spline on the pan axis, case toward -X

BUY_servo_tilt.why: spline +Y on the tilt axis 40 above the pan horn top, case below the axis and centred on the pan axis

BUY_cam.why: lens along +X through the tilt and pan axes, back 25 in front of the tilt axis, board up = +Z

BUY_horn_pan.why: pan horn on the pan spline

BUY_horn_tilt.why: tilt horn on the tilt spline

joints.name: PIV_pan
joints.why: pan about the pan axis, -90..90, carrying the bracket and the tilt servo

joints.name: PIV_tilt
joints.why: tilt about the tilt servo's spline, -25..60, riding on the pan

pan_servo.why: 4 M2.5 into the pan servo's bottom tapped holes

pan_bracket.why: 4 M2 through the pan horn's 0/90/180/270 holes, on the pan

tilt_servo.why: 4 M2.5 into the tilt servo's side tapped holes, on the pan

tilt_bracket.why: 4 M2 through the tilt horn's 0/90/180/270 holes, on the tilt

camera.why: 4 M2 through the camera board's holes, on the tilt

cover.why: 2 M3 join the cover and the deck

poses.why: the camera at (pan, tilt), brief signs (pan counter-clockwise from above, tilt + raises), against the analytic chain

clearances.why: brief: moving parts keep 1 mm from what they don't touch over the pan x tilt range
